issue_context.title: after flashback, pd schedule didn't resumed
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

1. execute 'flashback cluster as of timestamp xxxx'
2. after ddl return successfully, check pd schedule with "tiup ctl:v6.2.0 pd config -u http://10.2.xx.xx:2379 show"

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
hot-region-schedule-limit 4
leader-schedule-limit 4
merge-schedule-limit 8
region-schedule-limit 2048
replica-schedule-limit 64

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
hot-region-schedule-limit 0
leader-schedule-limit 0
merge-schedule-limit 0
region-schedule-limit 0
replica-schedule-limit 0

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

tidb patch

review_comments:
It will run success now, because we can't cancel flashback job in `writeReorg` state.
But if we support send flashback RPC, it will failed (unistore not support it now). I will modify it later.
Then there is a prbolem, plz check the unit test failure.
